meta.name: ecommerce-video-marketing
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者必备！当您需要为多品类商品策划抖音、小红书等平台的带货视频时，一键生成包含痛点切入、产品展示与专业镜头设计的6阶段高质量视频脚本，轻松打造高转化营销内容，大幅提升品牌销量。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把商品卖点生成带镜头设计的带货视频脚本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为多品类商品快速产出高转化带货视频脚本
copy.tagline_en: Turn product selling points into video scripts with shot design
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce high-converting product video scripts

howto.what: Claude 会按 6 阶段流程帮你写电商带货视频脚本：先问商品、人群、平台等信息，再产出「痛点切入→产品展示→痛点解决」的脚本，并附镜头类型、运镜与字幕音乐等后期建议。
howto.when: 当你需要为商品创作营销视频脚本，或需要电商视频营销指导时触发；它会先向你收集商品信息、目标平台与视频时长。

say.text: 帮我为这款自动喂食器写一条 30 秒的抖音带货视频脚本
say.note: Claude 走 6 阶段流程，产出完整脚本

say.text: 给这款护肤品做一条小红书脚本，面向 25-35 岁女性，风格简约高级
say.note: 会按你指定的人群与风格来写

say.text: 给这条 60 秒脚本补上镜头类型和运镜建议
say.note: 会附镜头与运镜设计说明

howto.what_en: Claude writes ecommerce video scripts in six stages: it asks for product and audience info, then produces a pain point → product → solution script with shot types, camera moves and post-production notes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need a marketing video script for a product or ecommerce video marketing guidance. It starts by collecting product details, target platform and video length.

say_en.text: Write a 30-second Douyin sales video script for this automatic pet feeder
say_en.note: Claude runs the six-stage flow and drafts the script

say_en.text: Create a Xiaohongshu script for this skincare product, minimal premium style
say_en.note: It follows the audience and style you name

say_en.text: Add shot types and camera move suggestions to this 60-second script
say_en.note: It adds shot and camera move notes
